title: cerastium brachypetalum subsp. atheniense
intro: Cerastium brachypetalum subsp. atheniense, commonly known as the short-petaled mouse-ear chickweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and it is believed to offer health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium brachypetalum subsp. atheniense include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote the recovery of damaged tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
